doc: Native libraries that Python wheels bundle (the auditwheel convention: <name>.libs/), by base name (the file name without its .so suffix and without auditwheel's hash suffixes). scripts/kit/wheel_libs.py reads this table at kit-build time, for every wheel the --with-wheels step fetches: a bundled library that is not listed here is refused, and a listed one is refused unless the wheel's own licence text carries a stanza (Name:/Files:/License:) whose Files: pattern matches the library and whose License: is exactly these spdx terms. A library with a GPL-family term (every OR-alternative a GPL-*, LGPL-* or AGPL-* licence, with or without a WITH exception) moves its wheel to the operator-supplied list, because the kit redistributes no GPL or LGPL code (docs/kit-operator-supplied.md; a python-wheel component of scripts/kit/operator_supplied.json). Licences are never guessed: add an entry only after reading the wheel's licence text. spdx is ' AND '-joined terms, no parentheses; each term is one SPDX id, 'id WITH exception', or 'id OR id'.

libscipy_openblas64_.name: OpenBLAS (with the LAPACK it bundles), scipy-openblas64 build
